reviews.reason: Table/workspace identity scopes the page, search and share target. A workspace switch can happen without a table event. Rendering checks the target identity and the sharing scenario ignores an old pending result after the switch.

The debounce now schedules only a changed normalized filename. Its callback commits that server filter and page 1 together; separate table/workspace identity changes clear scope-local state. The regression holds the page-2 request across the debounce boundary and requires a page-1 request and newest row after upload.
